body: K9: sneak+right-click your own tamed Wolf near a held Field Office to assign it as a K9 unit; diminishing-returns defense score (1+0.85+0.85^2+...) extends a Contest Window's duration and sets live K9s to target the challenger, matching NORTHSTAR.md's own VS2 acceptance criterion. Party Stores: sneak+right-click an un-designated Villager to designate it; real vanilla trading builds per-player goodwill; closes at night (world time 13000-23000) or force-closes 5 minutes after nearby PvP. Built, deployed to the live server, confirmed enabling cleanly with zero exceptions. Also confirmed live (not just curl-tested): a real player's join triggered a real IDUNA player_id WOTAN link, .GarbageMan4147 -> f9554ac4-ba5d-48fb-943c-7c8278ee95da.
title: VS2 -- K9 Doctrine + Party Stores
